name: Hotel Kögele
beschreibung: The Hotel Kögele is located in the village of Lermoos in the Zugspitz Arena in Tirol. The surroundings are shaped by the Zugspitze and the Wettersteingebirge. In winter, guests have access to the slopes of the Zugspitz Arena ski area. In summer, the paths in the surrounding area serve as a base for hiking. The amenities include a swimming pool and a sauna area. The restaurant mainly serves regional cuisine. The rooms are kept in a traditional style. Guests can expect a quiet accommodation with a direct connection to nature.
